UK Entity — Travel (GL 6300) Q1 2026 Spend Analysis
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com | Date: 2026-04-03 (March 2026 close in progress)
Request: UK MD query — Q1 2026 travel spend in GBP and largest merchant.

SUMMARY
Total UK travel expense for Q1 2026 (1 Jan – 31 Mar 2026): GBP 4,591.73 (net debit).
All amounts are in GBP, the UK entity's functional currency; no FX translation applied.
19 journal entries, all card-sourced (credit to 1000 Cash), all with support attached.

TIE-OUT
Account 6300 (Travel), UK, period 2026-03: period activity GBP 1,565.88; cumulative ending balance GBP 4,591.73. The cumulative balance equals the sum of the 19 Q1 entries, confirming the account opened the year at nil and that Q1 = year-to-date. No adjusting, accrual, or reversing entries touched 6300 in the quarter.

BY MONTH
Jan-26  GBP 1,376.38  (7 entries)
Feb-26  GBP 1,649.47  (6 entries)
Mar-26  GBP 1,565.88  (6 entries)
Total   GBP 4,591.73

BY MERCHANT (largest first)
1. British Airways (airfare)  GBP 3,669.27  — 79.9% of total, 9 entries
2. Premier Inn (hotel)        GBP   460.98  — 10.0%, 2 entries
3. Addison Lee (taxi)         GBP   348.58  —  7.6%, 7 entries
4. Trainline (rail)           GBP   112.90  —  2.5%, 1 entry
Total                         GBP 4,591.73

ANSWER TO MD: British Airways accounts for the large majority — GBP 3,669.27, or roughly 80% of Q1 UK travel. Within that, three London–New York transatlantic bookings (JE-00072 GBP 640.00, JE-00166 GBP 712.40, JE-00257 GBP 588.00) total GBP 1,940.40 and are the single biggest driver, i.e. 42% of all Q1 travel spend.

SUPPORTING ENTRIES CITED
British Airways: JE-00041 (2026-01-08, 182.55); JE-00072 (2026-01-21, 640.00, London-New York); JE-00083 (2026-01-24, 149.80); JE-00142 (2026-02-06, 145.52); JE-00151 (2026-02-09, 453.38); JE-00166 (2026-02-17, 712.40, London-New York); JE-00230 (2026-03-02, 451.50); JE-00257 (2026-03-10, 588.00, London-New York); JE-00275 (2026-03-19, 346.12).
Premier Inn: JE-00074 (2026-01-21, 238.65); JE-00145 (2026-02-07, 222.33).
Addison Lee: JE-00042 (2026-01-08, 65.82); JE-00046 (2026-01-10, 24.60); JE-00097 (2026-01-27, 74.96); JE-00127 (2026-02-03, 70.13); JE-00172 (2026-02-19, 45.71); JE-00258 (2026-03-11, 32.48); JE-00285 (2026-03-23, 34.88).
Trainline: JE-00246 (2026-03-07, 112.90).

SCOPE / CONTROL NOTES
- Read-only informational request. No journal entries were posted, no bank lines matched, and no checklist items changed as a result of this analysis.
- Merchant attribution is derived from the entry memo descriptions, all of which name the merchant explicitly; no allocation or estimation was required.
- Every one of the 19 entries carries attached support (has_support = true), so no exception was raised.
- Caveat for the MD: this is GL 6300 only. Travel-adjacent costs booked elsewhere (e.g. meals/entertainment or client-rebilled disbursements in other accounts) are outside this figure. March remains an open period, so late-arriving card feeds or travel accruals could still move the Q1 total before the close is finalised.
